## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
Curated passage-level parallels are found elsewhere in the Pali canon in the *Saṃyutta Nikāya* (*Purisasutta*, SN 3.2, and *Lokasutta*, SN 3.23) and in the verses of the Gāndhārī *Dharmapada* (G3-Dhp 61–70) [SuttaCentral]. The discourse is also cited or referenced in canonical exegetical works, specifically the *Cūḷaniddesa* (*Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa*, Cnd 23) and several sections of the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 1, 14, and 16) [SuttaCentral]. Machine alignments generated by DharmaNexus indicate substantial internal text reuse with the *Nettippakaraṇa* (*Sāsanapaṭṭhāna*, Ne 37, matching §2.1–2.4 with Ne §478.1–479.3), the *Tikanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 3 §69), as well as formulaic shared material across other *Itivuttaka* discourses (such as Iti 58, 66, 67, and 99) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus identifies cross-language textual alignments with the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99, scroll 24) [DharmaNexus].
